ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the role of whistleblowers and the response of state authorities.
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How have whistleblowers been treated by state authorities?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover widespread abuse and corruption in the Medicaid system, and could lead to significant reforms and accountability. By following the money and tracking the flow of funds, we can identify patterns and connections that may not be immediately apparent.
